mapper.insert: insert into report_task_step_log(task_id, step_code, step_name, status, detail, created_at) values (#{taskId}, #{stepCode}, #{stepName}, #{status}, #{detail}, now())
mapper.select: select step_code as stepCode, step_name as stepName, status as status, detail as detail, created_at as createdAt from report_task_step_log where task_id = #{taskId} order by id asc
